events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with multiple countries involved. This has significant implications for global oil prices and geopolitical stability. The US, China, and Russia are all major players in this conflict.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased oil prices, benefiting oil services companies. However, emerging markets may be negatively impacted by the conflict.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil price movements and geopolitical developments

events.exitStrategy: Exit if oil prices drop below $60/barrel

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The Federal Reserve is considering an interest rate hike due to rising inflation. This could impact the US economy and stock market.
events.reasoning: An interest rate hike could lead to increased bond yields, benefiting long-term Treasury bonds. However, the stock market may be negatively impacted by higher interest rates.

timeFrame.note: Monitor inflation data and Fed announcements

events.exitStrategy: Exit if interest rates drop below 4%

gains.extendedNote: If interest rates increase by 0.5% or more
